_purpose: Per-stat official engine for the live report from 2026 week 6, set by decision #42 (2026 holdout, weeks 1-4) and recorded in decision #43. v1.json is the locked engine list for the holdout and is not edited.
supersedes_for_display: engine/v1.json (v1 still describes the holdout lock)
spread_rule: The new model has no spread of its own. On a new-primary card the range, z and mp use the new model's mean with the old engine's sd_adj (sd x SD_INFLATE 1.10). Holdout RMSE: passing_yards new 83.50 vs old 83.72, rushing_yards new 26.15 vs old 27.09, so the old spread is not too narrow for the new mean.

passing_yards.official_engine: new model: LightGBM, data/shipping/passing_yards.pkl via scripts/vol_predict.py phase3_vol

rushing_yards.official_engine: new model: ridge, data/shipping/rushing_yards.pkl via scripts/vol_predict.py phase3_vol

receiving_yards.reason: #42 holdout: lift 0.64%, bar 2%, old engine stays

receptions.reason: #42 holdout: lift 1.85%, bar 3%, old engine stays

weeks_1_to_5: Published with the old engine for every stat. Their embedded data is not rewritten.
